name: Bros Eastern Co., Ltd. Class A
summary: Bros Eastern.,Ltd engages in the research and development, production, and sale of dyed mélange and color-spun yarns in China and internationally. It also offers greige mélange yarn. The company engages in dyeing and spinning activities. It sells its products in Europe, Asia, the United States, Hong Kong, and China. Bros Eastern.,Ltd was founded in 2004 and is based in Ningbo, China.
